Trigger.Name: README -> Description
Trigger.Description:
Thanks for checking out my repository.
Video on setting it up: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jcZ36lGypZ4
As of writing this readme there's:
Visual Buff Tracker: Creates bars for important buffs. Visual Cooldown Tracker: Creates a timeline to see when an ability is going to be up soon again. Visual DoT Timer: Creates bars for important DoTs that you need to stay on top off. Visual DPS Cooldowns: These are for Raid DPS Cooldowns, these only show up in instances. Visual Party Cooldowns: These are for seeing Swiftcasts, Shields and Cheat Death mechanics.
Most of the DoT regex's are taken from Aho's TTS callouts for them. Thanks Aho! MNK Demolish Regex taken from dansa (from Smol Cute Monk Suite). Thanks dansa! Idea of plugable party cooldown monitor taken from Illidra/Lombax. Thanks Illidra!
You can change the locations of the trackers by following these steps (thanks Aho for some of your text!):
1 - Make a folder in your Local Triggers, name it whatever you want, I call mine: Startup Folder 2 - Copy&Paste all the triggers in the "SETTINGS -> Copy to your Startup Folder" folder to that new folder (don't copy the whole folder, the startup folder doesn't trigger subfolders) 3 - Select said folder as a Startup Folder under : Options -> Edit Configuration -> General -> Startup Folder 4 - Doubleclick on the trigger that's relevant to the module you are trying to move/change. 5 - With the top action (doubleclick this to check X/Y) take note of the X and Y where your mouse is and decide where you want to move it. 6 - Then edit the X and Y action variable triggers to reflect what you have just taken note of. 7 - Restart ACT or disable/enable the Triggernometry Plugin
For the Visual Party Cooldowns you'll want to have Triggernometry's party list order the same as ingames. To change this go to Options -> Edit configuration -> Final Fantasy XIV tab -> Set ordering method to "Player first, sort the rest by custom party order". The options underneath this match the default FFXIV settings.
Make sure you set the PartyTrackerScale to whatever your party list scale is so the cooldowns line up with the player. So 80% = 0.8, 120% = 1.2 etc.
If you need help or want to send a suggestion my way you can contact me on Discord @Zeffuro#3033
